protocol.auroc: positive-negative pair concordance; ties receive half credit; null without both classes
protocol.average_precision: score-threshold grouped, non-interpolated; null without positives
protocol.comparison: identical complete candidate and outcome rows for every model

budget_match.note: no_retrieval sees zero evidence; comparators use the full historical graph

context.comparison: identical complete-query rows for every comparator
context.reading: high no_retrieval scores indicate post-cutoff recall, which caps what any evidence-conditioned model result on this packet can show

protocol.macro: equal query weights, excluding undefined values with eligibility counts
protocol.outcome_meaning: recorded by the horizon; unobserved does not mean disproved
protocol.precision_at_k: hits / min(k, eligible candidates); denominator reported per query
